snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The final briefing is over. The mission has been assigned. Now, it must be accepted.

Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is out now.

Take on the role of Noah, an agent sent to investigate the mysterious Ocean-I underwater station. But this is no ordinary mission. It is a descent into a world that defies logic, a journey to the heart of an ancient mystery where every clue threatens to unravel your sanity.

Your investigation begins today. Will you accept the mission?

Play now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S:
- https://www.nacongaming.com/cthulhu-the-cosmic-abyss?srsltid=AfmBOopdnwoC5oJUK95eT7Y_fTqanm5ajWvIr66Jcgny-8Swz4Lm8uyQ
PC players, your descent begins at 6 PM CET / 9 AM PDT: 
- https://steamcommunity.com/games/2760560/partnerevents
